nodes.description: Public array GameInfo[] games storing funder/winner data for every round.
Public counter of the current game index into games.
Mapping(address=>uint) of the last game index a user joined.
Mapping(address=>uint) of withdrawable ETH credited to funders/affiliates/manager.
Mapping(address=>address) referral graph used for multi-level reward payouts.
Address that receives the 10*count house fee; set to msg.sender in constructor.
Internal constant-like unit = 5 * 10^16 wei used for all pricing/reward maths.
Deploys the game, sets manager = msg.sender, self-referrers manager and pushes the first GameInfo.
Payable entry point: takes a referrer, records the funder, and when 10 funders are reached selects winners and credits rewards.
Lets a caller withdraw credited ETH from funderBalance and transfers it.
View helper returning the caller's last game data and balance.
View helper returning the current game data.
Caller-controlled address used as funder, balance owner, referrer and transfer recipient.
Block timestamp (now) used through addIn to derive the winning index.
funderBalance[msg.sender] += -amount; unchecked negation/subtraction of a caller-supplied amount.
msg.sender.transfer(amount); external ETH call to a caller-controlled address.
uint winNum = (now + gameNum) % 10; winner index derived from a miner-manipulable timestamp.
Reward loop: funderBalance[...] += 450*count / 300*count / 200*count / 10*count and count-based affiliate credits with unchecked arithmetic.
Referrer address supplied by the caller to addIn.
Amount supplied by the caller to withdraw.
Local winner index computed from timestamp and gameNum.
uint8 loop counter over the 10 funders in the reward loop.
Local address caching referrer(funder[i]) inside the reward loop.
GameInfo storage pointer to games[lastGame[msg.sender]] in getLastGame.
GameInfo storage pointer to games[gameNum] in getNewGame.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the funder, referrer owner and lastGame key in addIn.
msg.sender owns the funderBalance entry read and reduced in withdraw.
msg.sender keys lastGame and funderBalance lookups in getLastGame.
block.timestamp enters addIn and ultimately decides the winners, making payouts miner-influenceable.
manager is assigned from msg.sender in the constructor with no authorization or validation.
msg.sender selects which funderBalance slot is decreased by the unchecked '-amount' expression.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external ETH transfer in withdraw.
block.timestamp (now) directly determines winNum used to select the winner addresses.
The timestamp-based winner computation executes inside addIn when funderNum reaches 10.
The unchecked '-amount' balance mutation is executed inside withdraw.
The external ETH transfer is executed at the end of withdraw.
The unchecked reward distribution loop runs inside addIn after winner selection.
transfer() gives control to msg.sender which may attempt to re-enter withdraw; state is updated first and the 2300 gas stipend limits the attack.
The constructor pushes the initial GameInfo into games.
addIn writes funder/winner entries and pushes new GameInfo records.
getLastGame reads the funder and winner data from games.
getNewGame reads the current GameInfo from games.
addIn reads and increments gameNum and indexes games with it.
getNewGame returns gameNum and indexes games with it.
addIn reads and writes the caller's entry in lastGame.
getLastGame reads lastGame[msg.sender].
addIn credits rewards into funderBalance for winners, affiliates and manager.
withdraw reads and decrements the caller's funderBalance.
getLastGame returns the caller's funderBalance.
The constructor self-references the manager in the referrer map.
addIn sets referrer[msg.sender] and walks the referrer chain for payouts.
manager is initialized in the constructor.
addIn falls back to manager as referrer and credits the manager fee.
count scales the entry price check and all reward amounts in addIn.
funderBalance state is read/mutated around the external transfer; ordering (effects before interaction) mitigates reentrancy.
funderBalance is mutated by the unchecked arithmetic expression.
The referr parameter is consumed by addIn to configure the caller's referrer.
The referr parameter is written into the referrer mapping.
The amount parameter is the value validated and paid out by withdraw.
The amount parameter is subtracted from the caller's balance in an unchecked expression.
winNum is the locally computed winner index used to pick winners in addIn.
The loop counter i drives the 10-iteration affiliate reward loop in addIn.
addr caches the referrer of each funder during the reward loop in addIn.
The storage pointer game is read to return gameNum and winner data in getLastGame.
The storage pointer game is read to return gameNum and winner data in getNewGame.

normalization_plan.reason: The referr parameter has no independent semantic identity; it only feeds the referrer mapping inside addIn.
The amount parameter is meaningful only as the input of the withdraw balance check and payout.
winNum exists solely as the result of the timestamp-based winner index computation, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The loop counter i has no meaning outside the unchecked reward distribution loop.
addr is a transient cache of referrer lookups used only inside the reward distribution loop.
The storage pointer is a pure read alias of games inside getLastGame and can be inlined.
The storage pointer is a pure read alias of games inside getNewGame and can be inlined.
